generation.engine: ChatGPT-authored contextual translations only; no other translation engine is used
generation.qualityPolicy: Only reviewed ChatGPT-authored entries are displayed as translations. Missing entries remain in Japanese until ChatGPT-authored translations are added.
generation.traditionalChinese: Traditional Chinese entries are authored directly by ChatGPT; untranslated entries remain in Japanese.
generation.notice: The runtime loads only the same-origin ChatGPT-authored curated dictionary. No machine-translation fallback is available and page text is not sent to a translation API.

sourceInventory.scope: index.html plus user-facing JavaScript under assets/js
sourceInventory.fingerprintAlgorithm: SHA-256 of sorted unique Japanese source strings joined by LF
